mission: Recover, normalize, deduplicate, classify, test and merge useful legacy DreamCo bots and supporting files into one governed system without breaking the canonical fleet.

source_roles.attached_assets: supporting specifications, exports, notes, media and generated artifacts; not automatically bots

recovery_pipeline: enumerate every file in every source root
parse JSON Python JavaScript TypeScript Markdown text and YAML metadata where possible
extract bot identities classes functions capabilities categories and dependencies
compare exact identities against canonical fleet
compare fuzzy identity and capability similarity
dedup duplicate identities and capabilities against the canonical owner before creating any new bot
link duplicates to canonical owner instead of cloning them
extract unique capabilities from legacy duplicates as extension candidates
classify truly unique bot candidates into the best primary division/category
attach universal sandbox curriculum and Code Trust requirements
require runtime route before canonical fleet promotion
preserve supporting legacy files with provenance
generate one recovery manifest and promotion backlog
promotion_gate: Code Trust has no release blocker
truth_rule: Legacy files are source evidence, not automatically production-ready bots. Recovery must preserve provenance and never inflate bot counts by duplicating equivalent identities.
